description: Verify no endpoint or handler skips authentication without an explicit, reviewed opt-out (for example a public-route marker) and a stated justification.
Check that RBAC roles and attribute-based filters are enforced server-side in the API layer.
Flag any permission check that exists only in frontend code.
Verify rate limiting on authentication, password reset, and other sensitive endpoints.
Flag string concatenation or interpolation of values into SQL. Values must go through parameterized queries or the query builder's parameter binding.
Confirm dynamic column/table names use allowlists, never user input directly.
Check that API responses do not include sensitive data the client schema does not require.
Verify feature flags are checked server-side, not only in UI rendering.
Flag error responses that expose stack traces or internal system details.
Flag logging statements that might leak secrets, tokens, or full request bodies.
Check that S3/storage access uses signed URLs with explicit TTL.
